policy_name: OpenAPI 2.0 FormData to Tool Surface Governance Policy
epistemic_mandate: OpenAPI 2.0 formData parameters must never be converted to application/json body schemas. They must be synthesized into a discrete 'form' surface container under Draft-07 closed-object rules. File uploads and binary payloads are strictly prohibited. All field transformations must be explicitly classified as INTENTIONAL_REPRESENTATION_CHANGE.

surface_separation.rule: formData parameters are collected exclusively into a dedicated 'form' container: properties.form.
surface_separation.body_prohibition: formData parameters must NOT be mapped to properties.body.

ambiguity_rejection.rule: Operations declaring both 'formData' and 'body' parameters must be rejected fail-closed.

file_upload_prohibition.rule: Parameters with type: 'file' or binary format are strictly prohibited in benchmark tool contracts.

closed_object_enforcement.rule: The synthesized 'form' container must enforce additionalProperties: false.

wire_conformance_boundary.rule: No claim of actual HTTP wire conformance or live server serialization acceptance is made.

lineage_classification.rationale: OpenAPI 2.0 formData parameter mapped to discrete Draft-07 'form' surface container.

error_codes.ERR_FILE_UPLOAD_PROHIBITED: File upload parameters (type: file) are unsupported in tool contracts.
error_codes.ERR_BINARY_FIELD_PROHIBITED: Binary formatted payloads (format: binary/byte) are prohibited.
error_codes.ERR_BODY_FORMDATA_AMBIGUITY: Operation declares conflicting body and formData parameters simultaneously.
error_codes.ERR_UNSUPPORTED_COLLECTION_FORMAT: Array parameter specifies an unsupported collectionFormat.
error_codes.ERR_UNSUPPORTED_FORM_TYPE: Parameter specifies an unsupported primitive type.
